Choose a kind of game

The first three filters require an explicit developer declaration in the inspected source record. Missing evidence is excluded. These declarations are not a full playthrough guarantee. Mouse-only can still require dragging, and camera comfort does not mean a fixed camera. Holds and menu complexity still need your own check.

The filters below are editorial screening tags. Native co-op depends on the edition; sharing a single-player game does not count.

The unnecessarily elaborate procedure

Choose a department, mood and emblem. That gives a case immediately. Dice, snack arithmetic, traits and imaginary stamp tokens are optional. None describes your ability.

Unnecessary arithmetic and stationery

A session begins with three Stamp Tokens. At most one modification per case: spend a token for +2 OR one reroll of the four dice. Refusing a game never spends a token. Reset the session whenever you choose.
